dog.description_text: Meet Lily — New Arrival! She is currently in foster care and ready for adoption via our virtual process! Lily, a nine-year-old female, just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FLily%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQrDf4Vs%2D19zRp6BgsNe%5FBSTEgUD2XA%2D%2DQmKOhPEJlK7aalgjA Her foster says that after "2-3 day adjustment period Lily became very affectionate ...often seeking out pets, and she also enjoys head-butting us. She's taken up residence in my roommate's room and sleeps on the bed with her. I like that she's vocal and also affectionate, and responsive to me calling her." She is a super sweet girl. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
